# What you keep after Airbnb’s 15.5%.

> Free short-term rental host payout calculator: compare Airbnb’s 15.5% 2026 host-only fee with Vrbo (5% + 3%) and direct booking. See annual take-home, the nightly raise that restores your old 3% payout, and how much occupancy you can lose going direct and still break even.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
